purpose: T-PARTNER's hero card, standing where the homepage puts its product screenshot.
geometry: wrapper 50.4013em (537.61px), margin-top 81.067px; card 537.61x676.66, p-[2em] (21.333px), min-h 266.67px; widget box 490.95x630px — the 630 is a LITERAL px height that does not scale with the em engine
states: No hover, no active, no focus, no transition, no box-shadow.
externalEmbedPolicy: The ORIGINAL embeds a live third-party Calendly iframe plus widget.js. This clone strips every external domain by design, so the interior is the static components/block.scheduler-placeholder — the same stand-in /schedule-a-demo already uses. Nothing loads assets.calendly.com and nothing is interactive.

leaves.correction: CLONE_SPEC_CONTENT_B §5.5 says only the 8 scroll-tracked hero leaves are used and the 4 pure-drift ones are not. The RAW MEASUREMENT disagrees: _reference/recon-b/partner_50pros.json `motion[2..13]` shows all 12 present, 4 drift + 8 scroll. The measurement is followed. Raw recon beats spec prose.

scrollTrack: this wrapper carries data-scroll-track="hero" — it replaces the homepage screenshot wrapper that useScroll measures
